what: The system cursor is hidden and a 40px dot (.32 scale) follows the cursor, closing .4 of the remaining distance each frame. The dot color cycles through seven sunset tones (blue → gray → sand → orange) over 8s ease-in-out. Over links·buttons it turns translucent (.5) at .825 scale, and over photo cards ([data-cursor=project]) — over it the cursor grows 1.5× and a name tag pops up in the center at .28s (.46s cubic-bezier(.9,0,.1,1)). On press it twitches to .25× at 90ms (link .68 · card 1.23) and returns after 140ms. Quiet group ([data-cursor=subtle]) links are semi-transparent but keep their size

options.lerp: Share followed per frame, default .4 — the original case detail page uses .18
options.text: Label text — [data-fx-part=label] created when there is no child
options.project: Css target that grows large, default [data-cursor="project"]
options.subtle: Group css that does not grow, default [data-cursor="subtle"]
options.[data-fx-part=dot] · [data-fx-part=label: Dot/label child — created if there is no dot
options.--fx-tint-1 … --fx-tint-7: (css variable) Seven colors the dots cycle through, default is a sunset made by rotating from --kf-accent
options.--fx-cycle · --fx-rest · --fx-live · --f: (css variable) multipliers: color cycle (8s) · at rest (.32) · over links (.825) · over cards (1.5)

use:
View
— data-cursor on photo cards="project"

from.where: All pages .ab-cursor (the original script.js setupCustomCursor · custom-cursor.js uses .4, and project-page.js for work detail uses .18)

note: Not attached on touch, coarse pointers or reduced motion (system cursor stays)
